product.description: Monoprice™Standard Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port, UL®Expandable Cabling Platform with Six Openings for Maximum FlexibilityThe Standard Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port is a versatile, professional‑grade wall plate designed to support modern networking, audio, and video installations with precision and reliability. Built to accommodate up to six keystone jacks, this plate offers installers, IT professionals, and homeowners with a clean, organized, and durable solution for managing multiple connections in one location. Whether you're setting up a home theater, structured cabling network, or professional office environment, this keystone plate delivers both performance and aesthetic appeal.Crafted from high‑quality thermoplastic, the plate features a smooth black or gray finish that blends seamlessly with contemporary interiors. Its neutral tones make it an excellent choice for environments where design consistency matters, from residential spaces to offices, schools, and data centers. The standard size ensures compatibility with most electrical boxes and mounting hardware, making it equally suitable for new installations and upgrades.The six‑port configuration offers flexibility to mix and match different jack types‑such as Ethernet, HDMI®, coaxial, audio, or fiber optic‑so you can customize your setup without sacrificing organization. Each port provides a snug, secure fit that holds keystone jacks firmly in place, ensuring reliable connections and a professional‑looking finish.Durability and compliance are key advantages of this keystone plate. UL certification ensures the product meets rigorous safety and performance standards, making it ideal for professional installations where regulatory compliance is critical. The sturdy construction resists cracking, fading, and wear, delivering long‑lasting performance in both high‑traffic and low‑traffic environments.Installation is quick and hassle‑free with the included mounting screws and user‑friendly design. The smooth surface is easy to clean and maintain, helping the plate retain its polished appearance for years. For technicians, the standardized dimensions and universal port layout streamline installation while ensuring consistency across multiple rooms or buildings.In today's connected environments, cable management is just as important as connectivity. The Standard Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port not only reduces cable clutter but also creates a professional finish that enhances the overall appearance of any setup.
